text: Pharmacy is an interdisciplinary subject centered on the research and development, production, application and management of drugs, integrating knowledge from multiple disciplines such as chemistry, biology and medicine. The major aims to cultivate professional talents with capabilities in drug synthesis, formulation development, quality control, and rational clinical drug use, who can be engaged in drug research, production, dispensing, medication guidance, and pharmaceutical affairs management in scenarios such as pharmaceutical research and development enterprises, hospital pharmacies, drug inspection institutions, and pharmaceutical affairs management departments.
